Kimberly — reviewed. Summary: invoice amount €142,350 due 2025-07-15, payment blocked. Customer has historically paid on time; no service incidents. Risk level: medium (VAT documentation only). Recommendation:

1) Reissue corrected invoice to KiteWave EU S.à r.l with reverse-charge note (Finance can do this before EOB 2025-07-18).
2) Offer a single-payment extension to 2025-07-29 if KiteWave supplies the EU VAT registration and confirmation email by 2025-07-21.
3) Temporarily suspend automated late dunning escalation beyond standard reminders (do not apply credit stop or throttle services unless confirmation of non-payment by 7/29).

If KiteWave fails to provide VAT confirmation by 7/21, we escalate to credit committee for a hold/suspend recommendation. Laura, please queue the reissue and provide a copy once completed.
